lines.en: Excuse me. Is this cup glass or plastic?
It's glass, Ma'am. It's smooth and solid.
Do you have a plastic one? Glass breaks.
Yes. This plastic cup is light and hard.
lines.ko: 네. 이 플라스틱 컵은 가볍고 단단해요.

lines.en: Good. My grandson broke a glass cup yesterday.
Oh! Then plastic is safe for him.
What is this metal box for?
lines.ko: 이 금속 상자는 뭐에 쓰는 거예요?

lines.en: It's for paper and pens. It isn't sharp.
lines.ko: 종이와 펜을 넣는 거예요. 날카롭지 않아요.

lines.en: I will take the cup and the box.
Thank you. I will put them in a cloth bag.
Close your eyes. Touch this. What is it?
lines.ko: 눈을 감아요. 이걸 만져 봐요. 뭐예요?

lines.en: It feels rough and hard. Is it a stone?
Yes! Now touch this one.
It's smooth and cold. Is it glass?
Right. Glass is smooth. Metal is cold too.
This one is soft. It's cloth!
Yes. Yesterday you said paper was cloth.
This time I know. Is this plastic?
No. This spoon is metal. It feels smooth.
I will do this again tomorrow, Grandma.
lines.ko: 할머니, 내일 또 이거 할 거예요.
